entities.name: Kellan Boldt
entities.description: A young sorcerer, first son and heir to the Duchy of Kelsh, bound for the Tolarian Academy, who learns from Enthril that magic must be asked, not commanded.

entities.name: Enthril
entities.description: An old, scarred ship mage and Tolarian Academy graduate who has given up the pursuit of power for wisdom and takes Boldt as an apprentice.

entities.name: Archmage Ghavos
entities.description: The archmage who schooled Boldt in magic before his journey.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: A prestigious institute of magic in the Spice Isles that Boldt sails toward but never reaches.

entities.name: Spice Isles
entities.description: An archipelago, destination of Boldt's passage ship, that holds the Tolarian Academy.

entities.name: Duchy of Kelsh
entities.description: The duchy Boldt was heir to.

entities.name: The Perimeter
entities.description: A line of buoys with chained skeletons that marks the edge of the Dire Waves and lights up with accusatory shrieks.

entities.name: The Dire Waves
entities.description: A dark, whitecapped stretch of sea beyond the Perimeter, home to a vast leviathan.

entities.name: Talas Corsairs
entities.description: Pirates who ambush the passage ship with new chain-shot weaponry.

entities.name: Wellspring Magic
entities.description: The underlying magic of things that Boldt learns to ask rather than command.

entities.name: Boldt's Sextant
entities.description: A bronze sextant figurine given to Boldt by an instructor, used as a spell focus and lost during the wreck.

entities.name: Enthril's Signet Ring
entities.description: A gold signet ring bearing the all-seeing eye, which Boldt puts on as a reminder.

events.summary: Corsairs attack Boldt's passage ship with cannon fire.
events.quote: The cannonball missed him by inches.

events.summary: Boldt's attempted spell against a corsair fizzles.
events.quote: But as quickly as the spell sprang to life, it fizzled, uselessly impotent against the hull of the corsair.

events.summary: The corsairs' chained cannonballs cleave the mainmast, killing most of the crew.
events.quote: Mast, rigging, and crew came crashing down into the sterncastle and through the deck, bringing several screams to a sickening halt.

events.summary: Enthril emerges from below deck and uses a wave to spin one corsair into the other.
events.quote: The sea sprang to respond, following the motion and rippling with energy similar to Boldt's, but more powerful, confident.

events.summary: Enthril tells Boldt that they are all the crew that is left.
events.quote: We're the crew now. All that's left.

events.summary: Boldt and Enthril repair the hull below deck, Enthril telling him to use the mallet.
events.quote: Below deck, the pungent smell of hemp fiber and pine tar filled Boldt's nostrils.

events.summary: Enthril reveals he graduated top of his class from the academy Boldt is bound for.
events.quote: Graduated top honors.

events.summary: Enthril tells Boldt that control is an illusion and that he has learned to be a custodian of magic.
events.quote: Control is the illusion.

events.summary: Four pirate ships close in as the drifting sail pulls the ship east; Enthril gives Boldt a scimitar to cut the lines.
events.quote: Four sails on the water

events.summary: Enthril deflects mastcutters with an invisible barrier but collapses, depleted.
events.quote: With a thunderous clang, the heavy irons struck an unseen force at a shallow breadth before the bow.

events.summary: Boldt cuts the lines freeing the mainsail, and Enthril welcomes him to the real academy.
events.quote: Boldt cut through weathered ropes and rigging, bringing the blade down again and again until the tattered sail pulled itself free.

events.summary: Enthril stops Boldt from using his focus and tells him to ask rather than command.
events.quote: Don't speak. Don't command. Ask .

events.summary: A direct hit prompts Boldt to lunge, unleashing a surge of force that knocks the lead pirate ship broadside.
events.quote: A voltaic surge of force lashed across fathoms of ocean to catch the vanguard upright, knocking it violently broadside to port.

events.summary: The ship drifts toward the Perimeter, and Enthril names the Dire Waves as the worse problem.
events.quote: The Dire Waves. This is what worse looks like.

events.summary: The buoys blaze with light, the skeletons shriek, and a giant tentacle splits the ship across its keel.
events.quote: The appendage crashed through the middle of the ship, splitting it across the keel to send the mages airborne

events.summary: The wreckage lifts on the back of an immense shelled leviathan.
events.quote: Beneath them, the barnacled surface of an immense shell

events.summary: Boldt's calculating inner voice stops, and he finally sees how to let magic flow through him.
events.quote: And then the voice in his head, the voice of control, suddenly, inexplicably stopped.

events.summary: Enthril's blazing light engulfs the mages, the wreckage, the creature and the sea.
events.quote: The light exploded forth—engulfing the mages, the floating scraps of ship, the creature, the sea, the world.

events.summary: Boldt wakes alone aboard a strange skyship floating above the Dire Waves with Enthril gone.
events.quote: He was on a skyship of some kind, the make of which he could only have imagined.

events.summary: Boldt finds Enthril's signet ring, puts it on, and lets the winds carry him away from the Tolarian Academy.
events.quote: He put on Enthril's ring, as a reminder.

relations.note: He teaches Boldt to ask rather than command magic.
Boldt was schooled in the art by him.
relations.quote: schooled in the art by Archmage Ghavos

relations.note: The pirates reveal Talas colors and attack the ship.
relations.quote: Waited until the last second to show their colors, Talas colors, and surprise.

relations.note: The Academy lies within the Spice Isles.
relations.quote: Within it, the Tolarian Academy, his destination, approaching.

relations.note: He is the first son and heir of the Duchy.
relations.quote: first son and heir to the Duchy of Kelsh
